18.headline: Dončić outguns Cunningham as Queens topples the 2 seed
18.dek: Three teams are now tied at 10-8 around the playoff line after Ithaca edged a Gooning side missing five players, Waltham won a third straight and Rochester got blown out again.

games.text: Twenty-one lead changes, 251 points and not one stop anybody will remember. Luka Dončić scored 33 for Queens, clanking 12 of his 16 3-pointers along the way and winning anyway, 127-124, over Stony Brook. Cade Cunningham answered with 28 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists and has only a loss to show for it. The Pigeons jump from the 7 seed to the 6 seed at 10-8, level with the 4 and 5 seeds. Stony Brook has dropped two straight but keeps the 2 seed.

Gooning dressed seven players, which is a pickup game with a scoreboard, and still led by 10. Then Tyrese Maxey and Franz Wagner took over, scoring 36 and 34, and Ithaca escaped 112-109 to swap places with the Gooners: the Thunder are the 3 seed, Gooning slips to the 4 seed. Stephen Curry poured in 38 with seven 3-pointers while Karl-Anthony Towns, LeBron James, Jalen Brunson and two others watched in very nice jackets.

Scottie Barnes had a triple-double, 18 points, 11 rebounds and 13 assists, and it took him 20 shots to make seven, so let us call it a team effort. Jalen Suggs did the efficient part, 26 points on 11-of-15, and Waltham outlasted Nashville 116-110 through 20 lead changes with a 33-point fourth quarter. The Bears have won three straight and sit in the 5 seed with the same 10-8 record as the 4 seed. Nashville is 5-13 and has stopped checking.

Rochester trailed 39-23 after one quarter and by 31 before the Jays got bored. Toronto, the 8 seed, flattened the Dragons 119-106 behind Pascal Siakam's 27 on 11-of-16 shooting. Nikola Jokić put up 22 points, 17 rebounds and nine assists in the wreckage, which is like finding a grand piano in a landfill. That is four straight losses for Rochester, which has slid from the 6 seed to the 7 seed and is 9-9, a game out and heading the wrong way.

The 1 seed hosted the 10 seed and the 1 seed won, as the arrangement suggests. Cambridge beat Durham 111-99 for its fourth straight victory, though Victor Wembanyama needed 23 shots for his 29 points and nobody will frame the box score. Tyrese Haliburton scored 29 for the Destroyers, who were missing Anthony Edwards and Tyler Herro, have lost three straight and are 4-14. The Platypuses are 13-5 and a game clear at the top, a sentence that keeps getting typed.
